sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness pressures majors; WA exploration positives (copper-nickel-PGE, rare earths, gold) provide offset. Coal policy uncertainty under Albo government.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore. Exploration names (Dalaroo, Critica, Augustus) offer speculative upside. Coal exposure (WBC.AX, BRL.AX) faces policy risk.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advance on easing yields; however, RBA rate hike and IMF spending warnings create margin pressure. State governments face soaring interest costs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rising rates short-term but face credit risk if recession materialises. State debt servicing pressures may constrain fiscal stimulus.

sectors.trend: Middle East oil shock elevates crude; Australian gas export dynamics shift as Japan diverts LNG. Petrol price shock hits consumers. Victoria retreats from renewable transmission.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil volatility. Gas exporters (SGH.AX, GWO.AX) face Asian demand competition. Renewable policy reversal hurts CSP.AX, LEM.AX.

sectors.trend: Coles maintains high milk prices; Qantas strike threatens travel; fashion brands Cue and Veronika Maine near collapse. Housing unaffordability suppresses consumer spending.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CBA.AX (retail lending) face margin pressure. QAN.AX exposed to strike risk. Housing affordability crisis weighs on REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and construction.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn Queensland datacentre deal signals major capex. AI job displacement concerns. Meta talent war continues.
sectors.implications: Datacentre and infrastructure plays (WBC.AX, VMC.AX) benefit. ASX-listed tech remains thin; indirect beneficiaries include power and cooling suppliers.

sectors.trend: No major sector-specific headlines; defensive positioning likely supported by rate uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) remain defensive anchors in volatile environment.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs on bank strength and oil volatility, but RBA rate hike (95% priced) and Middle East escalation cap upside. Expect 2-3% volatility range. Iron ore weakness offsets energy gains.
market_outlook.long_term: Rising 2027 recession odds, IMF fiscal warnings, and housing affordability crisis create structural headwinds. Energy transition policy reversals add uncertainty. Critical minerals and AI infrastructure offer structural growth pockets. Moderate 3-5% total return expected over 12 months.
